title: SIGIL: Compiling Agent Skills into Typed Harnesses
evidence_locator: HTML §§1,3,4; abstract; evaluation: 30 skills, gpt-4o/gpt-5, prose vs compiled harness
notes: Typed AG-IR, source provenance, deterministic lowering and model/code ownership directly occupy compiler/runtime and enforcement territory; no strict four-state result contract or fixed small renderer.

title: FACTS: Table Summarization via Offline Template Generation with Agentic Workflows
notes: Offline reusable SQL+Jinja templates execute deterministically and render summaries; adjacent to offline compilation but not a strict epistemic result-interface study.

title: Skill Discovery for Software Scripting Automation via Offline Simulations with LLMs
notes: Offline LLM simulation creates execution-validated reusable scripts and beats runtime code generation on success/latency/token cost.

title: SkillRT: Compiling Skills for Efficient Execution Everywhere
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; 118k skills; eight LLMs; three harnesses; SkillsBench
notes: Capability-based compilation plus runtime/JIT solidification occupies portable skill compilation and small/large-model runtime efficiency; not formal epistemic result transport.

title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; web-search, math, coding evaluations
notes: Executable Program Functions act as guardrails and can be used inference-time or post-training; adjacent because final decisions remain agent-loop interventions.

title: Auto: The AGI Compiler
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; AUTO-BENCH; 560 spans; 300-item shifted stream
notes: Compiles witnessed-deterministic behavior into verified programs with calibrated guards/deopt; strong compiler/verification adjacency, but not four-state epistemic rendering.

title: SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; SkillsBench; Claude Code and Kimi CLI
notes: Strongly typed SkIR and compile-time analyzer occupy typed skill compilation, portability and compile-time enforcement; not authoritative domain-result semantics.

title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; qsv and GitHub-CLI evaluations
notes: Compiles heterogeneous external knowledge into structured executable skill contracts with evidence/confidence; procedural guidance rather than verified four-state decision result.

title: The Readout Shortcut: Positional Number Copying Dominates Arithmetic CoT Readout in Small Language Models
evidence_locator: arXiv abstract; three 1-3B instruction-tuned LMs; GSM8K/GSM-Symbolic; distractor and trailing-number controls
notes: Directly motivates answer-copying controls: small models often copy the trailing answer-like value instead of computing from reasoning.

title: PROTEA: Offline Evaluation and Iterative Refinement for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
notes: Scores intermediate artifacts and localizes likely faulty workflow nodes; relevant to layer-error localization but evaluator independence is not the same contract.
